title: The Familiar Surveyor
flavor_text: Use each lesson once, then use the order in which you learned it.
content: Seven mini-results are C, O, M, P, A, S, S. Their mechanisms repeat the prior lesson order: Caesar, odd positions, Morse, Pigpen-text, A1Z26, semaphore-text, substitution. Detect the callbacks, avoid rerunning solved transforms, then extract by lesson order.
